question: Can a prospectively frozen domain-specific approximation of the common viability-supervision operator select among equally resourced policies without assuming a universally beneficial gate?
selection_rule: Within each domain-size-rho development block, maximize success count, then the 0.10 quantile of physical margin, then minimize normalized energy plus communication cost; ties use candidate_policies order. No held-out outcome enters selection.
negative_result_policy: Retain no-window, no-improvement, gate-induced failure and supervisor-underperformance conditions.
claim_boundary: Prospective paired heterogeneous software-in-the-loop evaluation of an approximate viability supervisor; not an exact computed viability kernel, source-controller replay, hardware-in-the-loop or physical experiment.
